source.license: CC BY-SA 4.0; per-assertion license and source metadata retained

stratifiedProbe.policy: three stable-hash-minimum rows per observed English relation and weight band

scope.include: English-to-English assertions in the allowlisted relation policy with finite positive weight and parseable source metadata.
scope.exclude: Non-English endpoints, non-concept endpoints, malformed metadata, non-positive weights, and relations without a reviewed semantic policy.
scope.provenance: Retain relation, normalized endpoint URIs, dataset, license, sources, weight, and source-row identity.

physicalPlan.adapter: stream gzip line-by-line; never materialize the source archive
physicalPlan.canonicalShape: typed relation edge plus weight and provenance
physicalPlan.shards: relation family, then stable subject-name bucket; independent reverse index where query direction requires it
physicalPlan.runtime: query-directed immutable shard reads under byte-accounted LRU cache
physicalPlan.equivalence: compare a frozen stratified canonical sample against every compiled access path before promotion
